y-m-45-01.title: Singathi rhoqo 'ukuba ime nkqo, imveliso yamathambeka yi-−1'?
y-m-45-01.topic: Ubudlelwane phakathi kwamathambeka xa imigca emibini ime nkqo, nemigca engenathambeka

y-m-45-01.material:
민재 uthe, "Ukuba imigca emibini ime nkqo komnye nomnye, imveliso yamathambeka ayo amabini rhoqo yi-−1." Ngezantsi zii-nqununu ezine zemigca kwiplani yekhowudinethi. (x=2 ifundwa 'x ilingana no-2' kwaye ngumgca othe nkqo ongqamene ne-eksisi ye-y, kwaye y=5 ngumgca othe tye ongqamene ne-eksisi ye-x. y=−x/2+4 ifundwa 'y ilingana nokususa x phezu kwe-2 kudibaniswe no-4', kwaye 3x+2y=6 ifundwa '3x kudibaniswe no-2y ilingana no-6'.)
(가) y=2x+1 kunye no-y=−x/2+4
(나) y=3x kunye no-y=−3x
(다) x=2 kunye no-y=5
(라) 3x+2y=6 kunye no-2x−3y=1

y-m-45-06.title: Ingaba ukuhlola ngeseti enye yamanani kubungqina?
y-m-45-06.topic: Indlela yokubeka ukulungelelanisa nokuqhelekileyo, xa kubonisa impawu yemo ngokulungelelanisa
y-m-45-06.goal: Xa ubonisa impawu yemo ngokulungelelanisa, qokelela ukuba leliphi ulungiselelo lokulungelelanisa elimela onke onxantathu, uze uchazele umhlobo ukuba kutheni isisombululo esisebenzisa imo enye ekhethekileyo singabungqina.
y-m-45-06.material: Vumela M no-N babe ziziphakamisi zamacala amabini AB no-AC kanxantathu ABC. Ufuna ukubonisa ngokulungelelanisa ukuba isegmenti MN ifana necala BC kwaye ubude bayo bumisiwe kwesiqingatha se-BC. (√3 ifundwa 'intsika 3'.) Indlela obeka ngayo ukulungelelanisa iyabalulekile.
y-m-45-06.thinking.1: Ukufumana impazamo yokwenza isigqibo esiqhelekileyo kwisisombululo

y-m-45-06.prereq.2: Impawu yesegmenti edibanisa iziphakamisi zamacala amabini kanxantathu (isiphumo esaziwayo kwinqanaba lesikolo samabanga aphakathi)
y-m-45-06.s.s1.prompt: Ufuna ukubonisa le nyaniso 'kunxantathu ABC nawuphi na'. Khetha onke amalungiselelo okulungelelanisa anokumela onke onxantathu (angalahlekiyo ngokuqhelekileyo). (a, b, c zinonobumba abangathintelanga imo, njengokuba ngamanani apositive.)

y-m-45-06.s.s1.hint.1: Ngolungiselelo olufanayo, vavanya ukuba ungenza unxantathu one-engile yekona, unxantathu olinganayo, nayiphi na imo.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.a: Ilungisiwe ngamanani, ngoko ibonisa unxantathu omnye one-engile yekona kuphela.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba ubeka icala elinye kwi-x-axis nelinye iqhosha kwindawo ye-origin, iqhosha eliseleyo likhululekile, ngoko lingabonisa nawuphi na unxantathu.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.c: Ilungisa i-x-coordinate ye-A kwi-0, ngoko ibonisa kuphela onxantathu abane-engile yekona kwi-B.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.d: Ibonisa unxantathu omnye olinganayo kuphela onamacala onke amathathu ayi-2.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.e: Le yindlela yokubeka isiphakamisi secala BC kwindawo ye-origin. A ikhululekile, ngoko ingabonisa nawuphi na unxantathu.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.r.f: Ibeka u-A kumphambili wesiphakamisi secala BC, ngoko ibonisa kuphela onxantathu abangama-isosceles.
y-m-45-06.s.s1.explain: Ungaguqulela ujikeleze unxantathu ukubeka icala elinye kwi-x-axis (uwujike ukuba kuyafuneka ukuze A abe ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis) ubeke iqhosha elinye kwindawo ye-origin, okanye ubeke isiphakamisi salo mba kwindawo ye-origin. Ubude nobudlelwane obufanayo abutshintshi xa kuhanjiswa, ngoko b no-e zimela onke onxantathu. a, c, d, f zibonisa kuphela onxantathu abamo sele ilungisiwe, njengonxantathu one-engile yekona, unxantathu olinganayo, okanye unxantathu we-isosceles.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi ubeke A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3) wabhala njengaphantsi. Khetha umgca oyingxaki njengobungqina. (Ungakhetha umgca omnye kuphela.)
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.0: Phinda ubale ukubala kwimigca 2 ukuya kwi-4 omnye ngomnye ukubona ukuba kulungile kunxantathu lo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa iindidi zonxantathu ezinokwenziwa ngokulungelelanisa kumgca 1 noluhlu lomgca 5 oluthethayo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.0: Beka amaqhosha kanxantathu ABC njenge-A(0, 0), B(4, 0), C(0, 3).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.1: Isiphakamisi M se-AB yi-(2, 0), kwaye isiphakamisi N se-AC yi-(0, 3/2).
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.2: Ithambeka le-MN yi-(3/2−0)/(0−2)=−3/4 kwaye ithambeka le-BC yi-(3−0)/(0−4)=−3/4, ngoko MN no-BC ziyafana.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.3: MN=√(2²+(3/2)²)=5/2 kwaye BC=√(4²+3²)=5, ngoko MN sisiqingatha se-BC.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.line.4: Ngoko, kuwo wonke unxantathu, isegmenti edibanisa iziphakamisi zamacala amabini ifana necala eliseleyo kwaye ubude bayo bubuqingatha bobo.
y-m-45-06.s.s2.explain: Imigca 1 no-5 yingxaki. Ukubala (imigca 2 ukuya kwi-4) konke kulungile, kodwa kuba umgca 1 ulungise ukulungelelanisa nonxantathu omnye one-engile yekona, awukwazi ukuya kwi-'wonke unxantathu' kumgca 5. Okuhloliweyo kunxantathu lo mnye kuphela.

y-m-45-08.title: Ukuba utshintsha ulandelelwano lweenyathelo, isiphumo siyafana?
y-m-45-08.goal: Fumana impazamo kwisisombululo malunga nokuhambisa umgca, ufumane ugqibe imeko apho ukutshintsha ulandelelwano lokuguqulela nokubonisa ngomgca y=x kunika isiphumo esifanayo.
y-m-45-08.material: Ufuna ukuhambisa umgca m: y=2x+1 kabini. Inyathelo ㉠ kukuguqulela ngo-3 kwicala le-x (3 ekunene), kwaye inyathelo ㉡ kukubonisa ngomgca y=x. 지후 wenze ㉠ kuqala emva koko ㉡.
y-m-45-08.prereq.1: Ukuhambisa ifigure (ukutshintsha x nge-x−a kunye y nge-y−b)
y-m-45-08.prereq.2: Ukubonakalisa kumgca y=x kuthetha ukutshintshanisa x no-y
y-m-45-08.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca wokuqala kwisisombululo sika-지후 ohamba kakubi.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.0: Khetha ichaphaza elinye komgca ohambisiweyo uze usebenze umva ukubona ukuba lahanjiswa liphuma kwiliphi ichaphaza komgca wasekuqaleni.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.hint.1: Faka ichaphaza (0, 1) elikuyo m kulingano lomgca omtsha ukukhangela ukuba liya phi xa lihanjiswa ngokuya ekunene nge-3.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.0: Ukuhambisa m nge-3 kwicala le-x, faka x+3 endaweni ye-x: y=2(x+3)+1=2x+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.1: Ukubonakalisa lo mgca kumgca y=x, tshintshanisa x no-y: x=2y+7.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko isiphumo sokwenza ㉠ emva koko ㉡ yi-y=(x−7)/2.
y-m-45-08.s.s1.explain: Umgca woku-1 uhamba kakubi. Xa kuhanjiswe ngokuya ekunene nge-3, ichaphaza (x, y) elikwigrafu yasekuqaleni liya ku-(x+3, y), ngoko ulingano lomgca omtsha lufunyanwa ngokufaka x−3 endaweni ye-x: y=2(x−3)+1=2x−5. Imigca emva koko isebenzisa ixabiso lomgca woku-1 njengoko linjalo. Isiphumo esichanekileyo yi-y=(x+5)/2 ukusuka kwi-x=2y−5.
